newsitem.title: USA: US jet fuel jumps with futures, diffs mixed.
newsitem.headline: US jet fuel jumps with futures, diffs mixed.

text.p: U.S. spot jet fuel prices jumped sharply on Thursday tracking December NYMEX gains, with differentials easing in New York Harbor but firming a bit in the Gulf Coast in thin trade, players said.

Gulf aviation-quality 54-grade was sold for 1.25 cents under December futures earlier in the day, but was talked about 1.10 cent under late afternoon, 0.15 cent firmer than Wednesday diffs, players said.
Gulf low sulfur 55-grade firmed 0.25 cent, with offers at 0.50 cent over the print, traders said.
Differentials eased about 0.30 cent on New York Harbor 54-grade, traders said, to about 2.25 cents over December futures.
